=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:163-371 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The sync-only acceptance checks the commit range and file overlap against the tip (`sync_last_tip`) captured by the refresh loop's last `ls-remote`, but it never re-reads the base tip before accepting. It then runs the compare reads, the file listing and the head re-read before returning 0.
  WHY: An integration-branch commit that lands during those API calls falls outside `compare/<tested_base>...<sync_last_tip>`, so a foreign or overlapping commit can be wrongly accepted as `stale_accepted`. Reviewers disagreed on severity: gemini and openai rated it MAJOR, while minimax and glm rated it NIT, saying the window is small and the risk pre-dates this change; the highest rating is kept. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly did not report it, saying it is no worse than the existing `seen_tips` behaviour. glm suggests an API-free fix: re-run `ci_final_merge_ref_tip` before accepting and reject with `api_error` if the tip has moved.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:158-235 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: On the stale path, the sync-only check makes 4 GETs (compare/range, compare/default, the file listing per 100 files, and the head re-read), which exceeds the issue's "at most 3 extra GETs" budget.
  WHY: Each stale-path final-CI job uses one extra REST call, up to 33 for a 3000-file PR. Both reviewers rated it NIT. minimax notes the deviation is intentional and documented in the script header, README, agents fragment and changelog; sonnet and glm treat it as an accepted won't-fix.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A switch controls this (`CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED`, on by default)."
  expected_change_site: The “Verify the final-CI merge ref is current” steps in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The ten `.github/workflows/ci.yml` steps that run `scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh` map only `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_FRESH_ENABLED` and do not map `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED` from a repository variable. Actions therefore always uses the default `true`, and operators cannot turn this behaviour off on its own. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute this gap: the issue says "Entry point: unchanged", its Files list and the files_touched grant leave out `ci.yml`, and the README and script header document that the switch is read from the step env only.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:163-233 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The sync-only check makes several API calls (compare range, compare default, pull files) over time without checking that the tip SHA stays the same throughout.
  WHY: If the integration branch advances after the last ls-remote, the overlap and commit analysis uses a stale base and may accept a conflicting merge ref.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:163-233 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The stale path makes 4 extra GETs for PRs with up to 100 files, more than the specified limit of 3.
  WHY: This breaks the sync-only check's API budget and uses extra rate limit.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: A switch controls this (`CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED`, on by default).
  Expected change site: The “Verify the final-CI merge ref is current” steps in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
  Evidence of absence: The ten `ci.yml` steps that run `scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh` map only `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_FRESH_ENABLED`, not the new switch, so operators cannot disable it independently through a repository variable.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:lines around 354-371 (sync_last_tip capture and ci_final_merge_ref_sync_only invocation) and lines around 222-230 (the 4th GET head re-read) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The base tip is not re-verified right before acceptance, so the checked range trails the live tip by the time taken by about 4 API calls. `sync_last_tip="${tip:-}"` already fails closed when the last `ls-remote` fails.
  WHY: A commit that lands in that window could be wrongly accepted. Practical risk is very small; this is a known limitation, not a regression.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:lines around 158-235 (ci_final_merge_ref_sync_only), header comment lines around 25-72 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The stale path makes 4 GETs against the issue's #9688 cap of "at most 3 extra GETs".
  WHY: It does not fail at runtime: it costs one extra REST call (at most 33 for a 3000-file PR), and the deviation is intentional and documented in every artifact.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:Lines 328–329, 359–371; the acceptance check uses the captured tip in lines 168–180 and returns success after the PR-head check in lines 228–236. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The base tip is not re-checked before the stale merge is accepted.
  WHY: The branch can advance after the last `ci_final_merge_ref_tip` lookup while the compare and file-list requests run, so the merge is accepted against an earlier tip and final CI tests a merge that leaves out those commits.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: “A switch controls this (`CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED`, on by default).”
  Expected change site: The “Verify the final-CI merge ref is current” steps in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
  Evidence of absence: `ci.yml` does not map the switch into any of the ten check-step environments; it maps only `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_FRESH_ENABLED`, so the default `true` always applies.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:lines 355-371 (accept path) and lines 228-232 (GET 4) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The sync-only acceptance checks the range against `sync_last_tip` but never re-reads the base tip before returning 0, so a commit that lands during the check's own API reads is outside the checked range.
  WHY: The fail-closed rule for foreign or overlapping commits is bypassed during that window, and the script logs `outcome=stale_accepted`. Suggested hardening (risk score 2, about 4 lines): after the GET 4 head re-read, re-run `ci_final_merge_ref_tip` and reject with `api_error` if the result differs from `sync_tip`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
